flawed_step: Step 1 (case n = 2): the claimed equality already fails for the unique tree on two vertices.
counterexample: Let T be a single edge on two vertices. Then diam(T) = 1 and rad(T) = 1, hence diam(T) = 1 != 2 = 2 rad(T).
assessment_summary: The statement fails at the first allowed value n = 2, so no proof can be completed.
